verdict: Pursuit -> battle (Batmobile_V2_Tank_Spread_Open_Game f0 -> f60): turret +0.633 m, chassis -0.050 m, wheel splay 17.27-19.32 deg; full bbox 3.495 x 2.341 x 7.026 -> 4.691 x 2.865 x 7.443 m; 180/180 bones move, 64 articulate. Tank_Strafe adds 90.0 deg wheel yaw.

convention.mesh_frame: PSK: X length, Y width, Z up, centimetres
convention.jc3_frame: X width (left negative), Y up, Z length (front -Z), metres
convention.rotation_transform: rotate the axis with to_jc3_rot, keep the angle
convention.local_pose: metres/cm and PSK quaternion; missing channel falls back to bind local
convention.world_pose: world = q_child * q_parent; child offset rotated by inverse parent q
convention.bbox: linear-blend skinning of all 201,338 LOD0 points through the pose
